newsitem.title: INDIA: India cotton prices in fresh setback.
newsitem.headline: India cotton prices in fresh setback.

text.p: Indian cotton prices on Thursday suffered a fresh setback at improved levels on sluggish mill demand and profit-taking, dealers said.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi fell by 10/25 rupees to 885/950 rupees per maund. (37.32 kg) while F-414 declined by 20 rupees to 1,880/1,905 rupees per maund. Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) fell by 200 rupees to 12,000/12,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
Fresh arrivals also remained low as a major portion of the new crop has already been marketed and sentiments at the close remained subdued amid limited activity.
